capabilities.purpose: Explicit opt-in concurrency cap: count live projectiles for the same owner + generated item ID + exact entity ID, across all producers regardless of root/child, binding or input; pending scheduler entries are not live. The requested effective batch is admitted all-or-nothing when enough slots remain, otherwise refused; no clipping by this cap of the effective batch after existing global/depth/event-budget limits. count is per activation; concurrency is separate. Select maxActive=1 for one returned physical copy, or deliberately choose a larger positive cap. Same-ID different inventory copies and an alternate binding to the same entity share the cap. This does not override existing producer semantics: the owner-attached active-use singleton remains, and hold maintains one existing batch; maxActive>1 does not bypass repeat-use singleton or make hold refill to this cap. First-batch count retains its existing meaning. Late spawn refusal does not roll back other activation events or native item/mana costs. Capability absence adds no admission cap; no neutral/default is materialized, no name/category/movement routing and no other mechanic is selected.

Explicitly choose Projectile.sentry registration for this entity. enabled=true participates in the owner's native maxTurrets cap; Player.UpdateMaxTurrets runs immediately after each successful native sentry spawn and may retire the oldest sentry. Active item bindings project Item.sentry from their exact target. Lifetime, position, damage, collision, targeting and child budget remain separate authored choices; native sentry does not imply stationary movement or choose a weapon family. Omission preserves prior non-sentry behaviour.

Explicitly bound pending spawn reservations plus live descendants of each physical source projectile. A free root binding gets its own replenishable descendant pool instead of the monotonic activation event ledger; the root itself is excluded. A nested source adds this cap while retaining every ancestor pool and any ancestor lifetime ledger. All descendant event/controller producers share that ancestry; death or retirement releases only concurrent occupancy, never restores a lifetime allowance. Failed or cancelled spawns refund their reservation. Independent roots have independent pools; global owner/depth/entity caps remain. Absence retains the existing lifetime budget, with no fresh capacity created by network hydration.
Enable contact damage with explicit class, damage and knockback.
Set exact bounded entity lifetime.

Scale the native rectangular damage hitbox along an explicit active-age curve, independently of sprite/VFX size. Start/end are multipliers on set_projectile_hitbox.hitboxScale. Active world ticks begin after spawn activation delay; extraUpdates changes sample frequency, not duration. Optional visual coupling is an explicit mirrorToSprite choice. Beam and whip line geometry are excluded.

requirements.message: A hitbox curve multiplies the same entity's explicit static hitbox.
Rectangular hitbox curves cannot coexist with a beam/whip line-collision driver; choose the geometry explicitly.
mirrorToSprite=true owns dynamic sprite scale; expanding-wave movement or a visual scale curve is a second owner. Disable the mirror or choose one scale owner.

capabilities.purpose: Timed signed two-axis world acceleration, independent of the selected trajectory. Adds the authored vector after movement, turn and multiplicative speed, before absolute speed ramp and homing; zero axes are explicit. The compiler divides acceleration by the square of updatesPerTick so the same world-time phase gives the same world velocity change. It can launch a stationary zero-velocity projectile without inventing a direction.

requirements.message: Velocity modifiers require the explicit movement driver to own motion throughout their active phase.
Velocity modifiers require explicit movement, including on a target_and_fire entity.

capabilities.purpose: Absolute linear speed envelope over an authored active world-time interval. Unlike multiplicative speedModifier, speed at a given age is independent of prior magnitude and extraUpdates. After vector acceleration and before homing it preserves current heading and assigns a linearly interpolated start/end magnitude, reaching the endpoint on the last phase update. Outside the interval it releases velocity ownership. Zero velocity remains zero: this capability does not invent a launch direction. May compose with turn and targeting; a movement that replaces velocity each frame still receives the envelope in the fixed modifier pass.

requirements.message: Velocity modifiers require the explicit movement driver to own motion throughout their active phase.
Velocity modifiers require explicit movement, including on a target_and_fire entity.

capabilities.purpose: After the explicit movement driver, rotate velocity during an authored active-age phase. Fixed modifier order is turn, multiplicative speed, vector acceleration, absolute speed ramp, then homing. This is independent of the single movement slot; it does not create a trajectory or choose another driver.

requirements.message: Velocity modifiers require the explicit movement driver to own motion throughout their active phase.
Velocity modifiers require explicit movement, including on a target_and_fire entity.

capabilities.purpose: After movement and turn, multiply velocity on each active projectile update and clamp its magnitude to the authored cap. Values below one slow; above one accelerate. Phase timing is in world ticks, while the multiplier is explicitly per projectile update.

requirements.message: Velocity modifiers require the explicit movement driver to own motion throughout their active phase.

capabilities.purpose: After movement, turn, multiplicative speed, vector acceleration and absolute speed ramp, steer toward the nearest chaseable NPC within the hard radius, preserving current speed. Owner selects the target and synchronizes velocity. Equal distances use NPC index. Zero velocity stays zero; no target means no steering.

requirements.message: Velocity modifiers require the explicit movement driver to own motion throughout their active phase.

Scan NPC slots in index order, require chaseable positive-resistance targets within hard range, then apply at most maxTargets. Uses native resistance clamped 0.1..1. No periodic event clock or owner hit callback is substituted.
capabilities.safetyLimits: one bounded native NPC-array scan, at most authored 1..16 targets/update

capabilities.purpose: Set sprite/generic body scale to authored drawScale times visual.scale times an independent time curve. Linear or exponential interpolation uses active world ticks. This does not change damage or tile collision. Beam/whip line drivers are excluded because their exact body geometry uses collision dimensions. A separate gameplay hitbox curve can coexist only with its mirrorToSprite=false; no_asset still deliberately hides the body.

requirements.message: A visual scale curve excludes another scale owner and special beam/whip line geometry that does not consume sprite scale.

capabilities.purpose: Mirror the existing whip sweep and bend around its explicitly aimed axis when owner.gravDir is inverted. Does not change authored aim, range or damage; collision and body use the same whip points. Choosing this fn supplies the sole true wire marker.

Steer gradually toward a valid NPC.

Movement adds gravity as signed vertical acceleration per projectile update after activation, with no horizontal friction: negative accelerates upward, positive downward, zero preserves vertical velocity. Tile collision uses the separate bounceCount. No terminal-speed cap, rolling, resting or explosion is implied.

capabilities.purpose: Multiply velocity by authored retention per projectile update.

Orbit the owner at the authored radius and signed world-time angular rate, with an identity-based starting offset. Positive rotates clockwise on screen; negative counterclockwise; zero keeps the angle fixed while following the owner. Launch speed does not set orbit rate. This controller forces tileCollide=false.
Fly out, then return to owner. A wall collision starts return and disables tileCollide; does not kill or spend tile bounces. NPC penetration is authored separately.
Combine sinusoidal drift with bounded homing.
Couple a sinusoidal velocity-direction wobble with reduced opacity. This does not itself disable tile collision; tile collision is controlled separately.

Pull nearby chaseable NPCs toward the projectile and multiply projectile velocity by 0.99 per projectile update. Pull respects knockback resistance and affects at most 16 NPCs per update.
Pull nearby chaseable NPCs toward the projectile and multiply projectile velocity by 0.985 per projectile update. Pull respects knockback resistance and affects at most 16 NPCs per update.
Home; proximity inside triggerRadiusTiles triggers on_expire then on_kill and kills the missile. on_hit requires an actual hit, not mere proximity.
Fly, spin and return to the owner.

Tether to owner; outbound flight ends at the leash or when owner.channel becomes false, then return is latched. An active spawn root requires configure_item_use.channel=true: native StartChanneling(Item) otherwise leaves an idle owner unchannelled and return begins on the first AI. Passive/event-driven copies only observe the owner channel established by another active source; this controller does not start channeling.

requirements.message: An active flail spawn requires explicit item channel=true so native StartChanneling(Item) supplies owner.channel; release or reaching the leash latches return. Passive/event producers only observe existing owner channel.

capabilities.purpose: Follow the owner's cursor inside a leash and return on release. The same authored speed controls both cursor tracking and return, with velocity smoothing. This movement rotates the body by 0.35 radians per projectile update and does not turn the player toward the cursor; a child aiming by facing still uses the player's direction, not the rotating body. An active spawn root requires configure_item_use.channel=true: native StartChanneling(Item) otherwise leaves an idle owner unchannelled and return is latched on the first AI. Passive/event-driven copies observe existing owner channel; this movement does not start channeling.

capabilities.purpose: Execute the bounded owner-attached curved polyline from hand to tip; collision checks every segment, while Projectile.Center is the terminal point. Lash progress follows the owner's current itemAnimation/itemAnimationMax; the projectile remains active only while that animation is positive, including when an activation delay ends. A baked/reused PNG draws once at that tip, not along the curve. runtime_geometry draws the exact collision curve; a separately authored VFX texturedPath source=whip can accompany a baked tip. A channel_beam controller takes collision/geometry precedence. No automatic sprite stretching or representation selection.

Move the body center from owner center + aimed axis * (18px + triangular range displacement), extending then retracting during the cycle. The axis follows the live owner cursor (bounded synced aim for remote owners) every AI update, rotating both body and hitbox; not a fixed initial launch axis. configure_spawn.aim controls launch only, not this ongoing aim. This is not hand-attached: no native arm control, grip consumption or PNG stretching. It remains an independent legal movement choice.

Attach this explicit body's pose and collision center to the native front hand. Initial aim keeps the spawn axis; cursor aim follows synced live owner aim. No damage, lifecycle, visibility, asset or item-use choice is inserted. Collision center = native hand + aimed axis * hitboxOffsetPx, independent of PNG metadata; the existing axis-aligned rectangle is not pixel-matched blade collision. none-to-full stretch moves the hand only 6px; hitboxOffsetPx is a fixed center offset, not thrust reach or an extra sprite shift. Compare source use/collision geometry and resulting hand-to-damage coverage before deliberately choosing a short jab; sprite length alone adds no reach.

capabilities.purpose: Acquire NPC targets and periodically spawn an authored shot entity from this entity's current position. Explicit same-entity movement executes before firing. Explicit combat bases select the child's authored stats or this projectile's current damage/knockback; the selected damage is multiplied once, without repeating player/class modifiers. Volley count/spread belong to this controller; child spawn count/spread remain independent for its other producers. Shared activation, depth and owner budgets still bound spawning. Child configure_spawn aim=velocity consumes the acquired target direction, and position={at:activation_origin} consumes the firing entity origin; other explicit child aim/position choices remain literal.

Spawn a referenced authored entity when one supported event occurs. Explicit combat bases select the child's authored stats or the event-owning projectile's actual damage/knockback. Delayed actions snapshot live parent stats when enqueued, including terminal events; player/class modifiers are not applied again. Item-body events can select only authored_child.
